risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic low-power or unknown solar panel, not as a 200W unit

risks.risk: The panel may be damaged or have manufacturing defects not visible from the back.
risks.proof: A full front view of the panel, including edges and corners, to check for cracks, discoloration, or delamination.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or low-quality

Photo of the front showing the cell structure to confirm mono-crystalline type.
